parameters.name: SRT_ORDR
parameters.help: Use MB1 to pop up a menu of choices for the input traces' primary sort order (normally CDP).

parameters.name: SUM_MODE
parameters.help: This parameter specifies the method for estimating the output 'stack' trace.

parameters.name: SUM_ROOT
parameters.prompt: Root power scalar for stack normalization
parameters.help: This is the power exponent for contributing sample normalization (use 0.5 for square root scaling).

parameters.name: DIVR_AGC
parameters.help: This is the sliding gate operator length (similar to an AGC) used to compute the diversity scalars.

parameters.name: WGHT_HDR
parameters.prompt: SELECT Header Word for Trace Weighting
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header word to multiply its value times the trc samples before summing. See Header Weighting.

parameters.name: PERCENT
parameters.help: For Alpha-trimmed Mean stk, a 25% exclusion would reject the largest 12.5% and the smallest 12.5% of the samples.

parameters.name: DO_STAT
parameters.prompt: Apply final datum statics after stack?
parameters.help: If 'Yes', the data will be shifted to the final datum after stacking, using header entry FNL_STAT.

parameters.name: NMO_APLD
parameters.help: Normally, you will want to have applied NMO before stacking, but some exceptions may exist.
